description: T7-1 (docs/test-campaigns/phase-12.md): the cached Parser gets a (no-op) debug logger. Single-threaded nothing changes. But tree-sitter calls the logger on every lex/parse step, so Python runs mid-parse and the GIL can pass to another thread that enters the same singleton. Threads then overlap inside the non-reentrant C parser: the process crashes or the trees come back wrong.
